# KeepCrypt Pi Zero v1.3 (tasks/todo.md, M4 group 13). The default firmware (start.elf, fixup.dat)
# with the GPU memory of Buildroot 2026.08's tested board/raspberrypi/config_default.txt: 100 MB of
# the Pi Zero's 512 MB, about 412 MB left for Linux and scrypt's 256 MiB.
kernel=zImage
gpu_mem_256=100
gpu_mem_512=100
gpu_mem_1024=100
dtparam=spi=on
dtparam=audio=off
enable_uart=0
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
# The HAT's joystick and keys (BCM 5, 6, 13, 16, 19, 20, 21, 26) switch to ground: inputs with
# pull-ups, which the firmware sets again. The backlight (BCM 24) stays off until the firmware
# drives it.
gpio=5,6,13,16,19,20,21,26=ip,pu
gpio=24=op,dl
